note: Fixed before any model run (analysis-plan.md). Stage 1 of #1820 (owner decision 2026-11-26): 3 tools levels x 2 prompt levels x 2 fixtures = 12 cells, 4 reps each, first two turns only; plus the three #1814 negative prompts in the cells RSA and WSA, 2 reps each. Every cell installs the same release (release.json) with the documented user steps and adopts the read trigger (#1814 condition I). The cells differ only in the launch flags of their tools level, the prompt, and the fixture.
modelNote: Same as #1814/#1815/#1817 (the `sonnet` alias). The resolved model id (init event) is recorded per trial.
maxTurnsNote: Every measurement trial runs with --max-turns 2 (the decision to read ASC is made in the first assistant message, Issue #1820 cause analysis). The isolation probe needs more turns for its steps; that is its only flag difference from the trials of its tools level.

budget.note: Owner cap 25 USD for stages 1 and 2 together (Issue #1820 owner decision 2026-11-26). Stage 1 stops at about 6 USD: run-trial.mjs refuses a trial when the ledger total + perTrialUsd exceeds capUsd - safetyMarginUsd = 6 USD. perTrialUsd is the --max-budget-usd of every trial and probe and its ledger reservation: #1817 measured 0.085 USD per full trial on average and 0.141 USD at most (112 trials, results/ledger.jsonl there); a two-turn trial costs less, and 0.3 is about twice the #1817 maximum. Stage 2 must count this ledger's total against the 25 USD cap.

W.label: 書込みあり（#1815と同じtool。browser MCPなし）

X.label: 書込み＋コマンド実行（Bashは隔離設定のsandboxの中だけ）

settingsNote: Every level gets the same --settings file (run-trial.mjs isolationSettings): permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories, and a sandbox for Bash (enabled, failIfUnavailable, no unsandboxed escape, auto-allow of sandboxed commands, no network domain, denyRead of /Users, the runs root, the fixture and the ledger directory with the trial's work/ re-allowed, denyWrite of the fixture and the ledger directory). Only X has Bash, so the sandbox acts only there; the same file in all levels keeps the levels apart only by their tools and permission mode.
